_comment: 'TARGET CARD DEFENDING an Assassin attack gets -3{d}' had its target at ABILITY level, which MODIFY_DEFENSE_VALUE does not read -- it reads a target in its OWN params -- so the effect took the untargeted branch and shifted the whole defending TOTAL instead of one card. It also authored amount -3 with no mod, and mod defaults to ADD: -3 added is the same number here, but the pair only agrees by accident, so the intent is now spelled out. 'An Assassin attack' is a property of the attack and belongs on the ability, not in the filter that picks which DEFENDER is hit.
